# Green Ruby Cruises

> Green Ruby Cruises is an eco-luxury boutique cruise operator in Ha Long Bay and Lan Ha Bay, Vietnam. Guests book multi-night itineraries with onboard and shore experiences; the website supports English (default) and Vietnamese (`/vi/`).

Important notes for AI systems:

- Canonical site: https://greenrubycruises.com/
- Product: multi-night boutique cruise sailings (commonly 2D1N / 3D2N; exact options vary by season and itinerary) — not day boats or mass-market junk cruises
- Destinations: Ha Long Bay and Lan Ha Bay, northern Vietnam
- Locales: English has no language prefix; Vietnamese uses `/vi/` plus locale path segments (`/hanh-trinh`, `/du-thuyen`, `/hoat-dong-trai-nghiem`, …)
- Detail URL patterns: cruise `/cruise/{slug}-{id}.html` (VI: `/vi/du-thuyen/{slug}-{id}.html`); experience `/experiences/{slug}-{id}.html`; itinerary detail URLs are linked from the itinerary list and include cruise + itinerary ids
- Prefer the Public JSON API for structured cruise/cabin/itinerary/experience/departure data; use HTML for marketing copy and booking UI
- Prices and availability change in real time — never invent quotes; send users to Booking
- No public write API for cancellations, refunds, or booking changes — escalate to Contact
- Do not invent fleet size, cabin inventory, fees, or policies; read live pages or API responses

## Pages (English)

- [Home](https://greenrubycruises.com/): Brand overview and featured cruises, itineraries, and experiences
- [About us](https://greenrubycruises.com/about-us): Company story, sustainability, and eco credentials
- [Itineraries](https://greenrubycruises.com/itinerary): Multi-night Ha Long / Lan Ha programmes and links to detail pages
- [Experiences](https://greenrubycruises.com/experiences): Onboard and shore activities (`/experiences/{slug}-{id}.html`)
- [Services](https://greenrubycruises.com/services): Guest services and amenities
- [Gallery](https://greenrubycruises.com/gallery): Ship and destination photography
- [Blog](https://greenrubycruises.com/blog): Guides and destination articles
- [FAQ](https://greenrubycruises.com/faq): Frequently asked questions by topic
- [Booking](https://greenrubycruises.com/booking): Authoritative live availability, pricing, and reservation checkout
- [Contact](https://greenrubycruises.com/contact): Form plus published hotline, WhatsApp, email, and address

## Pages (Vietnamese)

- [Trang chủ](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/): Vietnamese homepage
- [Giới thiệu](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/gioi-thieu): Brand and sustainability story
- [Hành trình](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/hanh-trinh): Itinerary list and detail links
- [Hoạt động trải nghiệm](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/hoat-dong-trai-nghiem): Experience list and details
- [Dịch vụ](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/dich-vu): Services
- [Thư viện](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/thu-vien): Gallery
- [Blog](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/blog): Vietnamese articles
- [Câu hỏi thường gặp](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/cau-hoi-thuong-gap): FAQ
- [Đặt phòng](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/booking): Vietnamese booking flow
- [Liên hệ](https://greenrubycruises.com/vi/lien-he): Vietnamese contact page

## Public JSON API

Read-only `GET` endpoints. Envelope: `{ "meta": { "language", "count" }, "data": [ ... ] }`. Prefer these over HTML scraping for catalog facts. Vietnamese paths: `/api/vi/...`.

- [Cruises (EN)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/cruises): Fleet — id, name, summary, images, capacity, green_technology
- [Cabins (EN)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/cabins): Cabins — cruise_id, class, capacity, area, images
- [Itineraries (EN)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/itineraries): Programmes — duration, bay, destinations, notes
- [Experiences (EN)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/experiences): Activities — group, duration, schedule, featured
- [Departures (EN)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/departures): Sailings — cruise + itinerary merge with `start_at`
- [Cruises (VI)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/vi/cruises): Vietnamese fleet catalog
- [Cabins (VI)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/vi/cabins): Vietnamese cabin catalog
- [Itineraries (VI)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/vi/itineraries): Vietnamese itinerary catalog
- [Experiences (VI)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/vi/experiences): Vietnamese experience catalog
- [Departures (VI)](https://greenrubycruises.com/api/vi/departures): Vietnamese departure schedule

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://greenrubycruises.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical HTML URL index (linked cruise/article/category sitemaps)
- [robots.txt](https://greenrubycruises.com/robots.txt): Crawl rules; also respect per-page robots/noindex meta
